title: KongNai 4 Pieces Plastic Funnel Set for Kitchen and Automotive Use, Mini, Small, Medium and Large Funnel for Filling Bottles, Canning, Cooking, Lab or Car Oil Funnels (Red)
description:
About this item
Assorted Sizes Funnel for different purpose, different wide and neck diameters meet your different need. Water bottle funnel for transferring liquid, oils, and powders, kitchen funnel for canning, jar, food.
Save Space with overlapping design, 4 sizes form tiny to large funnels can nest, with hanging hole, so the funnel set requires minimal room in your kitchen drawer, school science room, camping bags, or car toolbox.
Durable Materials: High quality food grade plastic funnel, lightweight but durable, it won’t crack when dropped or with hot and cold temperature change. health food funnel for family.
Multi-purpose funnelsl: A must kitchen tool accessories, no more mess. Easy fast pouring funnel with a narrow spout fit almost any water bottle, narrow-necked flask, condiment or spice container, spray, liquor bottle, jar, beaker, vial, and cruet.
Easy Clean Up: Top-rack dishwasher friendly, Hand washing recommended. Narrow ends are slant-cut for cleaner pours, all funnels are easy to clean with soap and water.
